name: Ahmed Seleem
bio: Ahmed Seleem (أحمد سليم) is an Egyptian actor.

credits.title: The Knower
credits.overview: The film tackles cybercrime through the story of Younis, a man who lives with his wife and their baby girl, as he decides to rob a bank through the internet, but then finds himself chased by a dangerous gang.

credits.title: Kiss Me Not
credits.overview: Fajr is a famous temptation star, and the heroine of the first feature film of a young director. She rejects the kissing scene in the film, which provokes the director and the producer, and everyone tries to reach common ground to complete the film and get out of this dilemma.

credits.title: The Nile Hilton Incident
credits.overview: Cairo, 2011. A police officer investigates the murder of a woman in a luxurious hotel in the days leading up to the Egyptian revolution.

credits.title: The Consul's Son
credits.overview: After spending 30 years in prison, a man comes out to find out he has a son. Together with his son and a newly-acquired friend he resumes his criminal life.

credits.title: Messages from the Sea
credits.overview: A man witnesses the drastic changes in society as he goes back to the Alexandria of his youth.
